details: Effective range controls both the number of varying coordinates and class size.
proof: All concepts agree outside the effective range, hence $|\mathcal H|\le 2^{\mathrm E(\mathcal H)}$.  For a nonempty domain, $\log(n+1)\ge1$, so $\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(n+1)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / Log Size Ratio
